scope: Original cached-checkpoint Mimi input RVQ only: two independent semantic/acoustic input projections and eight greedy Euclidean codebooks; offline CPU reference, no hardware or serving
branch_contract: Both input projections consume the same source [1,512,1]. The semantic branch uses one codebook, the acoustic branch seven. Each branch greedily subtracts its selected centroid from its own projected residual.
native_selection: EuclideanCodebook._quantize computes torch.cdist(x[None], embedding[None], p=2)[0] then argmin(dim=-1), first index on a tie. Distances and first-versus-second winner margin are diagnostics in raw Euclidean units.
normalization: The existing native_quantizer helper normalizes embedding_sum by cluster_usage clamped at 1e-5 and checks all eight tables bit-exact against the original native embedding property.
device_candidate_scope: A future resident device candidate may minimize FP32 sum((residual-centroid)^2). Exact IDs must be independently verified for both raw accumulated and identical-input paths; Euclidean distances themselves are not claimed bit-exact to squared-distance arithmetic.
